description: Highlight probe (owner's Azul question + follow-ups, one Root). Not scored.

questions.question: If every color available to pick (in factories or center) is one I can't legally place in any pattern line, what do I do on my turn?
questions.expected_verdict: You must still pick tiles; they all go to your floor line.

questions.question: And if I'm the first to take from the center in that case?
questions.expected_verdict: Also take the starting player marker; it goes to the floor line too.

questions.question: What if my floor line is already full?
questions.expected_verdict: Excess tiles go to the box lid.

questions.question: How many points do I lose for a full floor line?
Can my warriors move out of a clearing my enemy rules?
questions.expected_verdict: Yes, if you rule the origin or destination clearing.
